learned: Core owns six handle lifetimes but TS decides clearing; generic cache preserves failure asymmetry and exact identity. Refresh succeeds before beginTurn; release clears before await and newly propagates async failure. Page forecasts worker survival/resource failure versus base worker death. Scope exported, files-only beginTurn, service-local construction, getOrCreate-only API, identical clear operations and core/backend placement are all choices. No removed tests; four TS handle clears and daemon effect lack direct added tests.
